lines.text: Let's move on to the next game.

data.define: To stop thinking about the past and continue.

example.text: Let's move on to the next game.

misuse.text: Don't tell someone to 'move on' after a loss.

publish.title: What does "move on" mean?
publish.value: Move on = Stop dwelling on it. Example: "Let's move on to the next game." (casual English).
